tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: Patina, the primary brand color: the logo's roof, primary buttons, link underlines, the focus ring, selected borders. As text it reads 4.91:1 on `surface` and only 4.45:1 on `bg` in light, so small text is `ink` with a Patina underline, and Patina text is kept to 600 weight at 19px+; 7.7:1 on `bg` in dark.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Ink, the second primary: all body text and headings, the logo's columns, base and wordmark. 14.3:1 on `bg`, 15.8:1 on `surface` in light; 15.1:1 and 13.7:1 in dark.

tokens.name: bg
tokens.usage: Limestone (light) and Night (dark): the page ground behind feeds and the rails. The logo's preferred ground.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Marble: raised grounds such as cards, the open post, panels, dialogs and buttons.

tokens.name: muted
tokens.usage: Slate: secondary text such as meta lines, captions, labels, hints and rail headings. 5.3:1 on `bg`, 5.9:1 on `surface` in light; 7.2:1 and 6.5:1 in dark.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairline: 1px borders on cards, buttons, inputs and between rows. Decorative only (1.2–1.4:1). Never the only thing that marks a control or a state.

tokens.name: accent-soft
tokens.usage: Patina tint: the ground of a selected item or an upvoted count, with an `accent` border. Text on it is `ink` (13.4:1); `accent` text on it is only 4.16:1 in light.

tokens.name: on-accent
tokens.usage: Text and marks on an `accent` fill: primary button labels, the app icon's mark. 4.91:1 in light, 7.74:1 in dark.

tokens.name: down
tokens.usage: Rust, an accent: downvotes, collapsed items, inline errors. 5.3:1 on `surface`, 4.8:1 on `bg` in light. Always paired with a word or the down arrow, never color alone.

tokens.name: down-soft
tokens.usage: Rust tint: the ground of a downvoted count. `down` text on it is 4.37:1 in light: keep it to the bold vote count, or use `ink`.

tokens.name: warn
tokens.usage: Ochre, an accent: notices that need a reader's attention (a write still pending, a node out of reach). 5.3:1 on `warn-soft`, 6.1:1 on `surface` in light.

tokens.name: warn-soft
tokens.usage: Ochre tint: the ground of a notice, with `warn` or `ink` text.

families.body: "Public Sans", system-ui, -apple-system, "Segoe UI", Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

styles.name: page-title
styles.usage: One per view: a community's name, a post's title on its own page, a profile's name. Sentence case.

styles.name: post-title
styles.sample: A forum no one can censor, one year in
styles.usage: A post's title in a feed (17.5px under 480px wide). The author's own casing is kept as written.

styles.name: section
styles.usage: Section and card headings inside a panel or the side rail.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Votes count from a community's members: the accounts its seeds' upvotes and follows reach.
styles.usage: Posts, comments, explanations. Keep lines near 65 characters.

styles.name: control
styles.usage: Buttons, the rail's links, form values. Primary buttons take 600.

styles.name: control-strong
styles.usage: The primary button's label, on `accent` in `on-accent`.

styles.name: small
styles.usage: Card and dialog copy, a profile's bio, tables.

styles.name: meta
styles.usage: Meta lines under posts and comments, field labels, hints, statuses. In `muted`.

styles.name: caption
styles.usage: Figure labels and the smallest notes. The floor for text: nothing smaller but the eyebrow.

styles.name: eyebrow
styles.usage: The rail's group labels, the one place for uppercase. Set uppercase with 0.08em tracking, in `muted`.

styles.name: data
styles.usage: Account IDs, CIDs, chain paths: anything a person may copy and compare character by character.

styles.name: graphic-headline
styles.usage: Social cards, slides and posters: one short line. Spectral 500 above 40px, where 600 turns heavy. A brand addition: the app has no type this large.

styles.name: graphic-subhead
styles.usage: The line under a graphic headline, or a slide heading.

styles.name: graphic-body
styles.sample: Every reader's client reads the chain, checks it, and decides what to show.
styles.usage: Supporting copy on graphics. Two or three lines at most.

tokens.name: space-2xs
tokens.usage: Between a meta line's items, an icon and its label.

tokens.name: space-xs
tokens.usage: Inside small controls, between buttons in a row.

tokens.name: space-sm
tokens.usage: The default gap between siblings: header controls, form rows.

tokens.name: space-md
tokens.usage: Card margins, notice padding, a post's rows.

tokens.name: space-lg
tokens.usage: Panel padding and the page's side gutter at every width.

tokens.name: space-xl
tokens.usage: Between sections of a panel or page.

tokens.name: space-column
tokens.usage: Between the rail, the feed and the side column.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Buttons, inputs, vote targets.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Media, notices.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Cards, panels, the open post.

tokens.name: radius-xl
tokens.usage: Dialogs.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Chips (sort orders, filters).
